maya: FYI sample app user hit inconsistent error shapes for auth/ratelimit, making retries messy.
sam: ugh, examples?
maya: iOS returns {"error":"Unauthorized","detail":{"code":401,"msg":"token expired"}} while JS throws HTTPError(status=401, body:"Unauthorized").
jordan: also 429 responses sometimes missing Retry-After header from Dedicated.
liam: proposal: standardize on typed exceptions in SDKs: AuthError (401/403), RateLimitError (429 with retry_after_seconds), ServiceError (5xx). also add stable internal_code and optional human_message.
sam: non-breaking path? feature-flag new fields, attach to existing error objects, keep old fields for now.
jordan: i'll add tests in sampleapp to assert typed exceptions and logging pattern.
maya: owners: sam (sdk + snippets), liam (server headers). will canary for 2w and monitor telemetry.
sam: i'll open PR with js/py snippets, changelog + sampleapp note to only log human_message + correlation_id.
